Why Choose 2500iu Vitamin D3?  
There’s nothing like a little bit of sunshine to boost our mood and improve our overall wellbeing. Sadly natural rays are elusive for many of us especially during winter months, so how can we enjoy the benefits of sunlight without exposure? Vitamin D supplements do an excellent job of replicating the benefits of the sun. Vegetology’s Chewable Vegan Vitamin D3 is created from lichens, an organic plant source, which ensures optimum absorption to support healthy bones, muscles, and your immune system.  
While our standard 1000iu dose is ideal for general daily support, some individuals may need a higher intake. If you spend limited time outdoors, have darker skin, cover up when outside, or are over 65, your body may struggle to produce enough vitamin D naturally. The 2500iu strength is ideal for those with higher needs—offering a more robust daily boost to help correct or prevent deficiency, support bone density, and maintain immune defences.
How does vitamin D help?  
Vitamin D helps regulate the amount of calcium and phosphate in the body, which we need to keep bones, teeth and muscles healthy. It promotes calcium absorption in the gut and also works to support the right levels of serum calcium and phosphate concentrations for bone mineralisation. This can prevent hypocalcemic tetany (involuntary contraction of muscles, leading to cramps and spasms).  
Vitamin D has also been reported to help stave off the flu virus. The human body can’t fight germs properly if it doesn’t have enough vitamin D.  
Healthy vitamin D levels can slow bone loss and fight off osteoporosis. If you’re prone to broken bones, it could be prescribed by your doctors to treat osteomalacia, a condition that causes soft bones, bone loss, and bone pain.  
Our skin produces vitamin D in reaction to UV exposure from the sun, but when there’s no sun, we could all do with a little vitamin D boost and supplements can do the trick.  
The benefits of Vit D3  
With so many vital roles in the body, it’s easy to see why maintaining healthy vitamin D3 levels is so important. Whether you're looking to support your bones and muscles, strengthen your immune system, or simply make up for a lack of sunlight, Vegetology’s Vegan Vitamin D3 2500iu Tablets offer a convenient, plant-based way to give your body the support it needs—naturally and effectively.
